- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:259-272 (_shell_segments_with_operators), 471-474 (_push_targets), 1284-1290 (_evaluate_bash) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook copy is missing three critical changes present in the template copy.
  WHY: The root hook checks the wrong branch for pushes after file-descriptor redirects, does not request confirmation for unresolved push destinations or sources, and never resolves named source refs to commit SHAs for ancestry checks. test_template_copies_are_identical in tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py requires byte-identical copies and would fail on this divergence.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1345-1349 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The confirmation message for bulk git pushes still reads "Bulk git push may write more branches than the current branch" instead of "Git push may write branches or source tips the guard could not verify".
  WHY: When the guard requests confirmation for an unresolved push destination or source, the operator sees a misleading message that names only the branch-count concern and omits the new source-tip-uncertainty case.
